name: mc_blueprint
title: Blueprints
description:
Stores reusable blueprints, generates architectural parts, fits foundations and entrances to one bounded terrain capture, and stages large cell uploads. No world placement.

WHEN TO USE: reusable windows, columns, towers or rooms; keeping a design across calls or sessions. Generate a part or save your own design, then build it with mc_build {blueprint:{id}, transform:{origin,...}}. Components use mc_build's fills/shapes/blocks/text entries and orientation rules.
WHEN NOT TO USE: terrain inspection, placement or previews. fit is optional site adaptation, not a mandatory check.

PARAMETERS: action save/get/list/delete/generate/fit/stage/finalize/tag/touches. id: 1-64 characters, lowercase letter first, then letters/digits/_/-. save: a version-1 document of flat components (local pos/rotation/mirror, project-frame repeats; no nesting); materials as $role or $role[property=value]; precedence component defaults < document palette < mc_build blueprint.palette < instance palette; dimensions/constraints are advisory; overwrite:true replaces. tags {module, status draft|built|approved, undo: <blueprint id>, note}: tag merges changes (null removes one), list {tags} filters, touches {from,to} lists blueprints whose bounds meet a box (bounds are world bounds only for blueprints in absolute coordinates). stage {name, cells (up to 50,000 per call), reset} appends cells; finalize {name} checks them and writes a file for mc_build cellsFile (up to 2,000,000 cells; unfinished uploads expire after a day). generate {id, generator}: gable/hip/shed roofs, round/pointed arches, round towers, straight/switchback stairs; generation is additive and never clears openings or interiors; use connect:false to keep explicit roof corners. fit {id, site}: solid or pier foundation and an optional descending entrance from one read-only capture; it rejects hazardous or unknown anchors, obstruction, missing headroom or landing; it never excavates; the result is site-specific (origin and build recommendation, plus `protected` rows, reported only) and its air filters can skip supports if the site changes.

SIDE EFFECTS: save/generate/fit/tag/delete change blueprint files only; get/list/touches are read-only. At most 256 documents, 2 MiB each, 128 components, 10,000 operations and 4,096 expanded instances; generation caps 200,000 cells and validates native states before saving. Saving checks structure only; mc_build validates compiled states before any write. Deleting a blueprint never removes built structures.

tags.description: tag: changes merged into the stored tags (null removes one). list: only documents whose tags equal every given value.

from.description: touches: inclusive [x, y, z] corner of the box.

to.description: touches: inclusive [x, y, z] corner opposite from.

overwrite.description: save/generate/fit only. Default false; explicit true permits replacement.

cells.description: stage: up to 50,000 absolute [x, y, z, "block_state"] cells appended to the upload.

reset.description: stage: discard earlier pieces of this upload first.

site.description: fit only. One bounded read (at most 200,000 cells); footprint 1-64 per axis. floorY is the walking level (deck at floorY-1). Anchors must be natural full blocks (no vegetation, liquids, gravity or protected blocks). Output is additive and air-filtered; nothing is cleared or reserved.

maxDepth.description: Distance below deck to search; read must also fit world Y and volume limits.

spacing.description: Piers only: grid intersections plus far edges, with a full deck.

width.description: Defaults min(3,side span), must fit that span.

offset.description: From low X for north/south or low Z for east/west; default centered.

maxRun.description: Also <=maxDepth; default min(16,maxDepth). Descends until a level terrain landing; no upward routing.

full.description: Occluding non-gravity material; default stone bricks.

stairs.description: Stair state; default stone brick stairs. Generated facing/half/shape override binding properties.

generator.description: generate only. Local axes: gable ridge along Z, shed rising east, arches in the XY plane with depth along Z, stairs rising south (then north for switchback). Footprints include eaves. materials: full (solid block), stairs (stair state), slab (slab state); defaults stone bricks for arches/towers, oak for stairs, dark oak for roofs. Saved as an ordinary version-1 blueprint.

gableInfill.description: Gable only; fills end triangles below the roof. Slope 1:1.

height.description: Pier/spring-line height, not total crown height.

rise.description: Pointed only; <= (width+1)/2, defaults to that maximum.

merlons.description: Requires battlements; alternating angular sectors, voxel approximations.

gap.description: Switchback only, empty well between flights.

supports.description: Solid plinths under flights/landings; not terrain-aware foundations.

document.description: save only. Flat components in local coordinates; dimensions and constraints are kept as metadata.

undo.description: Blueprint id that undoes this one.

constraints.description: Optional advisory requirements, kept verbatim; not enforced.

palette.description: Role name -> literal block state. No recursive $role bindings.

components.description: Names use the id format. Each holds mc_build operations and optional material defaults; no nested instances.

block.description: Literal block state or $role, optionally with [properties] to override palette properties.

filter.description: Partial block-state filter, including optional $role. Omitted properties remain wildcards.

block.description: Literal block state or $role[property=value]. Orientation rules are the same as mc_build; supply both door/bed halves.

component.description: Name of a component in this document.
